title: The boundary of the payment environment is documented and reviewed at least annually
description: A diagram and written description show which systems, networks and connections are inside the payment environment and which are not.

title: Every system inside the payment environment is recorded in an inventory
description: The inventory names each in-scope system, its owner and its function, and is updated when systems join or leave the environment.

title: Network traffic into and out of the payment environment is limited to what is needed
description: Connections are denied by default and each permitted flow has a recorded business reason.

title: Card numbers are never stored in readable form
description: Stored card numbers are tokenised, truncated or encrypted so that a copy of storage does not expose them.

title: Keys that protect payment data are managed through their whole lifecycle
description: Generation, storage, rotation, retirement and destruction of keys follow a written procedure with named custodians.

title: Payment data is kept only for as long as there is a documented need
description: A retention period is set for each kind of payment data and data beyond it is securely deleted.

title: Access to payment data is limited to people whose job requires it
description: Access is granted by role, approved by the data owner and reviewed at least twice a year.

title: Administrative access to payment systems uses multi-factor authentication
description: A second factor is required for every administrative login, wherever it originates.

title: Activity on payment systems is logged and the logs are kept for a year
description: Logs capture who did what and when, are protected from alteration and remain available for at least twelve months.

title: Payment systems are scanned for vulnerabilities at least quarterly
description: Scans run after significant change and at least every three months, and high-severity findings are fixed before the next scan.

title: People who work in the payment environment receive security awareness training every year
description: Training covers handling of payment data, recognising social engineering and reporting suspected compromise.

title: A suspected compromise of payment data is handled under a written incident plan
description: The plan names who to notify, including card schemes and the acquiring bank, and within what time.
